propositions: Project routing overlay cannot currently extend built-in overlay triggers; registry functions read only committed routing and hardcoded deletion-impact regex
Project entries must support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matches on diff lines) and applies_to globs unioned with committed globs on built-in overlay ids
Helper function project_trigger_extensions must read raw project overlay entries directly (bypassing effective_routing) and return per-overlay-id token and glob extensions
glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must union project trigger extensions with committed triggers, with backward compatibility: no project entry yields current behavior
Malformed project entries (non-list tokens, non-string token values, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions
Unit tests in new test_code_review_triggers.py module must cover happy path, removed-line matching, glob union, negative control with no overlay, and malformed input handling
